name: __SLUG__-heroku
description: Heroku's manifest. It sits at the repo root because Heroku deploys the branch main from GitHub as it is. Heroku's Node buildpack runs npm ci here, then npm run build (with NODE_ENV=production, so each folder installs its dev dependencies on purpose, builds, then prunes them), then the Procfile's web process. npm start runs the same server. The release version is backend/package.json's, not this one's.

scripts.build: npm ci --prefix backend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build --prefix backend && npm prune --prefix backend --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund
